open_hop: The per-type handle object *(*(type+8)+0x28) and its vtable +0x10 are created by protected code and cannot be pinned statically. soldier_warp resolves the chain read-only at runtime, logs a census line and reports leaf=pinned only when the hop is the handler itself or an argument-preserving forwarder to a soldier subobject whose vtable +0xa8 is 0x1360f90.
limitations: Static analysis only; no game code was executed.
The open hop above is proven only by a runtime census and handled=1.
Positions are host-local; guards may walk back to their route or be moved by navmesh correction.
Thread: the engine sends this message from player update; this mod sends it from the Lua owner thread (the same thread that already moves the partner body through the same transform slots).
